_doc: Modifiers for WordEngine (DESIGN.md §5a, Modifiers.luau). kind (also application order): Size, Count, Mood, Quality, Element, State, Motion (Material comes from data/materials.json). a = aliases (may be multi-word), ms = known misspellings, size = size steps, count = multiply count, power/speed/durability = additive deltas, b = behaviours added, t = tags added, mood = Types.Mood, ac = visual.accents (builder-rendered ids only), colour/colour2 = primary/secondary override, tint = light colour tint, motion = visual.motionHint override, element = element (visuals tint toward elements[element]). Totals are capped by Config.Modifiers.
